prompt:
I'm a VC analyst preparing a filing intelligence briefing for our partners meeting on Monday. I need you to scan for any material regulatory filings (specifically the kind that announce significant corporate events, not routine quarterly/annual reports) from semiconductor and cloud AI companies over the last 72 hours. 

Please save the results as `filing_alert_report.md` — it needs to be a properly structured briefing that clearly distinguishes high-priority disclosures from routine ones, includes a plain-English explanation of what each filing means and why it matters to us, and finishes with an analytics summary showing how many filings were found, how many were high-signal versus medium-signal, and any cross-source intelligence previews available. Our partners need to be able to scan this document in under 2 minutes.
